`tests/test_totals.py` now passes, and so does the rest of the suite (5 tests).

The bug was in `to_cents` in `ledger/currency.py`. It used `int(amount * 100)`, which truncates. `19.99 * 100` evaluates to `1998.9999999999998`, so the result was 1998 instead of 1999. I changed it to `round(amount * 100)`.

`to_cents` still takes float input, so it only fixes floating-point noise at the cent level. If amounts can carry fractions of a cent, they will round to the nearest cent. For stricter money handling, pass prices as `Decimal` or strings.
